reviews.title: JSI Intros PROGUE, Moog Prodigy & Rogue Inspired DIY Analog Synthesizer
PROGUE: forthcoming Moog Prodigy and Rogue inspired DIY analog synthesizer

videos.title: PROGUE - Moog Prodigy & Rogue inspired DIY Analog Synthesizer

pull.q: JSI packs the feature sets and sound characters of the vintage Moog Prodigy & Rogue together and transforms both into a new analog DIY Synthesizer called PROGUE.

quotes.t: It is a new development but is based heavily on two well-known vintage synthesizers from Moog, the Prodigy, and Rogue. The final result is very reminiscent of a classic Moog instrument.
